content.short: Nest offers on-chain vaults that earn yield from institutional-grade real-world assets.
content.description: Nest gives users access to real-world assets sourced from global financial institutions through on-chain vaults, earning a variable stable yield with transparent reporting. Its Nest Savings mini app runs inside World App and is listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: Nest offers RWA-backed yield vaults on-chain, with a Nest Savings mini app in World App.
content.pageTitle: Nest - Real World Asset Dapps - Lancers Web3 Explorer
